summary: Made #434 the single landing candidate for the approved UI stack: merged current main (the squash-merged #268 duel/UI work, #298, #444/#445, #449-#452) into it, main winning in src/L5R.Core and #434's presentation winning in the client, with main's duel client code preserved rather than reverted. Also cleared the findings inherited from #410, #429 and #430: target bars now apply on every target channel (CardIds, a sequenced second target, a redirection), a copy-of-target creation naming a scan is refused instead of throwing out of the session, client and server advertise one protocol version (bumped to 2), and a dependent slot's candidates are no longer tied to the default earlier selection.
validation: Windows local: Core 1071, AI 76, server 8, transport 16, collaboration 45, content 134, Meshy 6 pass; Core/test builds zero warnings. Each of the five fixes has a regression shown failing without it. Godot client build/import and native visual/input checks not run locally (no pinned Godot on this machine); CI macOS/Windows to confirm.
remaining: Alfredo's hands-on acceptance of the Top Cards result and the other previews in this stack. Client follow-ups already requested in #448. #275 still needs its own re-scope against current main.
